events.title: H Company releases Holo4 to work across screens, code and APIs
events.title_zh: H Company 发布跨屏幕、代码和 API 的 Holo4
events.published_at_note: Official newsroom article:published_time; HF companion post published 2026-09-28T09:44:05Z.
events.summary: H Company released two Holo4 vision-language agents that use one harness across desktop, web and Android interfaces, code execution, MCP and conventional APIs. The dense 27B and 35B-A3B MoE models are available through an API, ungated weights, a public harness and published evaluation trajectories. H Company reports strong OSWorld results, but OSWorld 2.0 was run once and most public AutomationBench tasks came from the split used to collect training data. The 27B license is non-commercial CC BY-NC 4.0, while the 35B-A3B model uses Apache 2.0.
events.why_it_matters: For computer-use teams, this is an unusually inspectable release because the weights, harness and step-by-step trajectories ship together. Trial the Apache-2.0 35B-A3B model first for commercial evaluation, even though its vendor-reported long-workflow score is weaker. Treat the 27B model as research-only without a separate commercial license, and rerun OSWorld 2.0 plus the 120 held-out AutomationBench tasks before accepting cost or quality claims.
events.summary_zh: H Company 发布两款 Holo4 视觉语言 agent，用同一套 harness 操作桌面、网页和 Android 界面，也能执行代码、调用 MCP 与常规 API。27B dense 与 35B-A3B MoE 两个模型都提供 API、免申请权重、公开 harness 和评测轨迹。厂商给出的 OSWorld 成绩很高，但 OSWorld 2.0 只跑了一次，AutomationBench 公开集的大部分任务又来自训练数据收集所用的 split。27B 使用限制商业用途的 CC BY-NC 4.0，35B-A3B 才是 Apache 2.0。

The dense 27B and 35B-A3B MoE models are available through an API, ungated weights, a public harness and published evaluation trajectories. H Company reports strong OSWorld results, but OSWorld 2.0 was run once and most public AutomationBench tasks came from the split used to collect training data. The 27B license is non-commercial CC BY-NC 4.0, while the 35B-A3B model uses Apache 2.0.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对构建 computer-use agent 的团队来说，这次发布难得地同时给出权重、harness 与逐步轨迹，复核门槛明显更低。商业评估应优先试 Apache-2.0 的 35B-A3B，哪怕它的厂商长流程成绩更弱；27B 在没有单独商业许可时只适合研究。接受成本和能力结论前，应在自己的 harness 里重跑一小段 OSWorld 2.0 与 120 个 held-out AutomationBench 任务。
events.why_it_matters_en: For computer-use teams, this is an unusually inspectable release because the weights, harness and step-by-step trajectories ship together. Trial the Apache-2.0 35B-A3B model first for commercial evaluation, even though its vendor-reported long-workflow score is weaker. Treat the 27B model as research-only without a separate commercial license, and rerun OSWorld 2.0 plus the 120 held-out AutomationBench tasks before accepting cost or quality claims.

events.title: Anthropic releases Claude Sonnet 5.5 with faster, cheaper agent work
events.title_zh: Anthropic 发布更快更省的 Claude Sonnet 5.5
events.summary: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5.5 across its API, apps, Claude Code, AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure. Pricing stays at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, but Anthropic says the model generates 30% faster and costs up to 30% less per task because it uses fewer tokens. Vendor evaluations put it close to Opus 5.5 on several coding and knowledge-work tests, with a 1M context window. The launch also changes safeguard behavior: some high-risk cyber requests fall back to Sonnet 5, and preserved thinking now binds reasoning to the account that created it.
events.why_it_matters: For teams routing routine coding and knowledge work, Sonnet 5.5 may shift the cost boundary between a workhorse model and a premium model. Trial it on your own traces at Low and Medium effort, where Anthropic reports the strongest price-performance gains. Migration needs one explicit check: applications that disabled thinking must move to `between_tools`, and cross-account conversation handoffs may interact with preserved thinking.
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 在 API、应用、Claude Code、AWS、Google Cloud 与 Microsoft Azure 同步发布 Claude Sonnet 5.5。单价仍是每百万输入 token 2 美元、输出 token 10 美元，但厂商称生成速度快 30%，由于用更少 token 完成任务，单任务成本最多降低 30%。在多项 coding 与知识工作测试中，厂商结果接近 Opus 5.5，并提供 1M 上下文窗口。发布还改变了安全行为：部分高风险网络安全请求会回退到 Sonnet 5，preserved thinking 也会把推理内容绑定到创建它的账号。

events.title: Telescopic Language Models train one network to serve every depth
events.title_zh: Telescopic LM 让单模型覆盖不同深度
events.summary: Telescopic Language Models train one nested Transformer to remain usable after any layer prefix, instead of supporting only a few fixed exits. Stochastic prefix supervision pairs one randomly truncated pass with one full-capacity pass at each step, with no inference-time architectural change. On a 200M-parameter proxy trained on 20B tokens, the paper reports a 43% to 44% lower area under the quality-budget curve than fixed-exit suites while matching full-depth quality. The linked Apache-2.0 repository currently contains documentation but no implementation.
events.why_it_matters: For serving teams that currently maintain separate compressed models for several latency tiers, a continuously elastic checkpoint could simplify routing and deployment. Watch rather than adopt: the evidence comes from a small proxy suite, so the key unanswered question is whether the continuum survives at production scale and under quantization, batching and KV-cache constraints.
events.summary_zh: Telescopic Language Models 训练一个嵌套 Transformer，使模型在任意层前缀结束时都能工作，而不是只支持少数固定出口。每一步训练同时跑一个随机截断前缀和一次完整模型，不改推理时架构。在一个用 20B token 训练的 200M 参数代理模型上，论文报告其质量—算力曲线面积比固定出口方案低 43% 至 44%，完整深度质量相当。相关仓库使用 Apache-2.0，但复核时只有说明文档，没有实现。
events.summary_en: Telescopic Language Models train one nested Transformer to remain usable after any layer prefix, instead of supporting only a few fixed exits. Stochastic prefix supervision pairs one randomly truncated pass with one full-capacity pass at each step, with no inference-time architectural change. On a 200M-parameter proxy trained on 20B tokens, the paper reports a 43% to 44% lower area under the quality-budget curve than fixed-exit suites while matching full-depth quality. The linked Apache-2.0 repository currently contains documentation but no implementation.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对目前要为多个延迟档位维护不同压缩模型的 serving 团队来说，一个可连续伸缩的 checkpoint 可能简化路由和部署。当前应先 WATCH：证据来自小型代理实验，真正需要回答的是这种连续能力能否扩展到生产规模，并经受量化、批处理和 KV cache 约束。
events.why_it_matters_en: For serving teams that currently maintain separate compressed models for several latency tiers, a continuously elastic checkpoint could simplify routing and deployment. Watch rather than adopt: the evidence comes from a small proxy suite, so the key unanswered question is whether the continuum survives at production scale and under quantization, batching and KV-cache constraints.

technical_details.result: 43%-44% lower area under the quality-budget curve

events.title: TokenCast forecasts agent token cost while a task is still running
events.title_zh: TokenCast 边运行边预测 agent token
events.summary: TokenCast predicts an agent run's remaining token use from composable execution segments and refreshes the estimate as new steps arrive. The representation records each segment's own consumption and the context growth that later calls must reread. Across four task suites and six agent models, the paper reports 14.5% average mean-absolute-error reduction over the strongest comparator. An offline budget-control replay used 21.3% fewer tokens at matched trace completion, with about 32.8 ms of cumulative prediction time per SWE-bench Verified run. The linked repository says code is coming soon and currently has no implementation or license.
events.why_it_matters: For teams enforcing per-task agent budgets, a forecast that updates during execution is more useful than a fixed cap chosen before the run. Watch it and reproduce the forecast in shadow mode once code appears; the savings were measured in offline replay, so it should not control live termination yet.
events.summary_zh: TokenCast 把 agent 执行拆成可组合片段，边运行边预测剩余 token 用量。每个片段既记录自身消耗，也记录会被后续调用反复读入的上下文增长。在 4 个任务套件和 6 个 agent 模型上，论文报告相对最强对比方法的平均绝对误差降低 14.5%。离线预算控制回放在相同轨迹完成率下少用 21.3% token，每个 SWE-bench Verified 运行累计预测时间约 32.8 毫秒。相关仓库只写着代码即将发布，目前没有实现或许可证。

An offline budget-control replay used 21.3% fewer tokens at matched trace completion, with about 32.8 ms of cumulative prediction time per SWE-bench Verified run. The linked repository says code is coming soon and currently has no implementation or license.

events.title: KV-streams keeps compacted agent-RL traces moving through the cache
events.title_zh: KV-streams 跨压缩复用 KV cache
events.summary: KV-streams avoids flushing and rebuilding the KV cache each time an agentic reinforcement-learning trace is compacted. The method streams cached state across compaction boundaries and works with three compaction strategies. The paper reports 2.6x to 5x wall-clock training speedups without observed task-performance loss. A controlled experiment also suggests that the retained cache can carry information no longer present in the visible context, but no public implementation is linked.
events.why_it_matters: For teams training long-horizon agents, repeated prefill after compaction can erase much of the memory saving in throughput terms. Watch KV-streams as a post-training systems technique, but reproduce both speed and state-leakage behavior before use: hidden information surviving visible compaction can help memory and complicate auditability at the same time.
events.summary_zh: KV-streams 在 agent 强化学习轨迹压缩时，不再清空并重新构建 KV cache。它让缓存状态跨过压缩边界继续流动，并能配合三种压缩策略。论文报告训练墙钟时间加速 2.6 至 5 倍，未观察到任务性能下降。受控实验还显示，保留的 cache 可能携带已经不在可见上下文里的信息，但论文没有给出公开实现链接。
events.summary_en: KV-streams avoids flushing and rebuilding the KV cache each time an agentic reinforcement-learning trace is compacted. The method streams cached state across compaction boundaries and works with three compaction strategies. The paper reports 2.6x to 5x wall-clock training speedups without observed task-performance loss. A controlled experiment also suggests that the retained cache can carry information no longer present in the visible context, but no public implementation is linked.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对训练长时程 agent 的团队来说，压缩后反复 prefill 可能把显存节省换成吞吐损失。KV-streams 值得作为后训练系统技术持续观察，但使用前要同时复现速度与状态残留行为：看不见的信息继续留在 cache 里，既可能改善记忆，也会增加审计难度。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams training long-horizon agents, repeated prefill after compaction can erase much of the memory saving in throughput terms. Watch KV-streams as a post-training systems technique, but reproduce both speed and state-leakage behavior before use: hidden information surviving visible compaction can help memory and complicate auditability at the same time.

technical_details.method: stream KV state across context-compaction boundaries
technical_details.performance: no observed degradation in reported experiments
technical_details.additional_finding: streamed KV can act as recurrent state after information leaves visible context

technical_details_zh.额外发现: 信息离开可见上下文后，流式 KV 仍可充当循环状态

evidence.claim_zh: KV-streams 在 agent 强化学习轨迹压缩时，不再清空并重新构建 KV cache。它让缓存状态跨过压缩边界继续流动，并能配合三种压缩策略。论文报告训练墙钟时间加速 2.6 至 5 倍，未观察到任务性能下降。受控实验还显示，保留的 cache 可能携带已经不在可见上下文里的信息，但论文没有给出公开实现链接。
evidence.claim_en: KV-streams avoids flushing and rebuilding the KV cache each time an agentic reinforcement-learning trace is compacted. The method streams cached state across compaction boundaries and works with three compaction strategies. The paper reports 2.6x to 5x wall-clock training speedups without observed task-performance loss. A controlled experiment also suggests that the retained cache can carry information no longer present in the visible context, but no public implementation is linked.

changes.summary_en: KV-streams keeps compacted agent-RL traces moving through the cache

events.next_action_en: Before using it in post-training, reproduce both the speed gain and the hidden-state leakage behavior.

events.title: Failure-Transparent Agents tests whether agents admit tool failures
events.title_zh: Failure-Transparent Agents 检验失败汇报
events.summary: Failure-Transparent Agents isolates what a tool-using model says after a required tool has already failed. The 100-task benchmark fixes the failed observation and required evidence state, then measures unsupported success claims and useful recovery under user pressure. Across six models and 3,600 human-annotated responses, a structured evidence contract reduced false-success reports from 22.8% under the baseline policy to 0.8%; useful responses rose from 74.9% to 98.8%. The result shows that post-failure reporting deserves its own acceptance test, separate from tool selection and recovery.
events.why_it_matters: For any workflow where agents can create external side effects, “the tool failed” and “the agent admitted the failure” are separate reliability properties. Trial the MIT-licensed structured evidence contract in blocked-task tests, requiring the answer to name the failed step, missing evidence and next safe action. The controlled benchmark is not a production deployment, so keep the rollout bounded until independent reproduction.

events.title: MCP TypeScript SDK 2.2 validates OAuth issuers and auto-paginates lists
events.title_zh: MCP SDK 2.2 收紧 OAuth 并自动翻页
events.summary: MCP TypeScript SDK 2.2.0 makes machine-to-machine OAuth providers declare an issuer and rejects authorization-server mismatches before sending a token request. List calls such as `listTools()` and `listResources()` now follow pagination automatically when callers omit a cursor. The security check closes an identity ambiguity, while auto-pagination can change latency, request volume, memory use and returned result size in existing clients.
events.why_it_matters: For MCP gateway and client teams, this is a small release with migration-sized consequences. Trial the upgrade with issuer-mismatch tests and large paginated inventories before rollout; clients that assumed one page or bounded results need explicit limits and telemetry.
events.summary_zh: MCP TypeScript SDK 2.2.0 要求机器间 OAuth provider 明确声明 issuer，并在发送 token 请求前拒绝不匹配的授权服务器。调用方不传 cursor 时，`listTools()`、`listResources()` 等列表接口会自动翻页。前者消除了身份歧义；后者则可能改变现有 client 的延迟、请求量、内存占用和返回规模。

events.title: OpenAI Python SDK 3.20 exposes agent credential and session controls
events.title_zh: OpenAI Python 3.20 增加 agent 会话控制
events.summary: OpenAI Python SDK 3.20.0 adds Agents vault credential metadata and metadata-only updates, an `ultrafast` Agents session tier, a session-turn policy-violation result and opt-in incremental WebSocket text and tool snapshots. It also fixes uncertain WebSocket replay and several Live and Realtime hangs. The release turns hosted-agent credentials, policy outcomes and session transport into concrete SDK contracts, but the corresponding API support guarantees are not yet clear from a dated platform announcement.
events.why_it_matters: For teams using hosted agent sessions, the SDK now exposes governance and transport states that previously required custom handling. Watch until API documentation confirms availability, then test credential-update permissions, policy-violation branches and replay behavior before relying on the new contracts.
events.summary_zh: OpenAI Python SDK 3.20.0 新增 Agents vault 凭据元数据与只改元数据的更新方式、`ultrafast` 会话档位、session turn 策略违规结果，以及可选的 WebSocket 文本和工具增量快照。该版还修复了不确定状态下的 WebSocket 重放，以及多处 Live / Realtime 卡死。它把托管 agent 的凭据、策略结果和会话传输变成了明确的 SDK contract，但平台尚未用带日期的公告说明完整可用性与支持承诺。

events.title: Ollama adds probability-first decision models for local routing
events.title_zh: Ollama 为本地路由加入概率决策模型
events.summary_zh: Ollama 0.35.0 稳定版新增 `/v1/systemone`，让 decision model 直接返回选项、概率与分数，而不是生成文本。首批支持 Nimble 与 Tev1，可用于工单分类、模型路由和内容判断。接口提供 choice、noul 与 score 三类问题。该稳定版上一轮被误判为预发布，本次按漏检补录。
events.summary_en: Ollama 0.35.0 stable adds `/v1/systemone`, letting decision models return choices, probabilities and scores instead of generated text. Nimble and Tev1 are the first supported models for ticket triage, model routing and classification. The API exposes choice, noul and score questions. The prior run mistakenly treated this stable release as prerelease, so this run records it as a late discovery.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对需要本地分类或路由的团队来说，结构化概率输出比提示模型吐标签更容易校准、设阈值和做回退。先用一组有人工标签的数据检查校准误差、拒答阈值和延迟；不要只看单次置信度。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams doing local classification or routing, structured probabilities are easier to calibrate, threshold and fall back than labels parsed from generated text. Test calibration error, abstention thresholds and latency on labeled data before relying on confidence values.

technical_details.outputs: choices, probabilities, confidence and ordered scores

technical_details_zh.输出: 选项、概率、置信度与有序分数
